title: Lifetime Withdrawal Percentage Table — Fixed Indexed Annuities
content:
## Lifetime withdrawal percentage by age

On the Ashgrove Fixed Indexed Annuities tiers, the lifetime withdrawal percentage is read from the table below by the covered person's age when lifetime withdrawals start; on joint lifetime income the age read is that of the younger covered person. The percentage for the highest age in the table that is not above that age applies.

| Age when lifetime withdrawals start | Lifetime withdrawal percentage |
|---|---|
| 50 | 4.0% |
| 55 | 4.5% |
| 60 | 5.0% |
| 65 | 5.5% |
| 70 | 6.0% |
| 75 | 6.5% |
| 80 | 7.0% |

The same table is printed for all six tiers — IndexEdge 5, IndexEdge 7, IndexEdge 10, IndexEdge 10 Bonus, IncomeShield 7 and IncomeShield 10.

### Equivalent banded reading

| Age band at the start | Percentage from the table |
|---|---|
| 50 through 54 | 4.0% |
| 55 through 59 | 4.5% |
| 60 through 64 | 5.0% |
| 65 through 69 | 5.5% |
| 70 through 74 | 6.0% |
| 75 through 79 | 6.5% |
| 80 and above | 7.0% |

### Hypothetical lookups

- Age 54 at the start: the highest table age not above 54 is 50, so 4.0%.
- Age 55 at the start: 55 is itself a table age, so 4.5%.
- Age 67 at the start: the highest table age not above 67 is 65, so 5.5%.
- Age 86 at the start: the highest table age not above 86 is 80, so 7.0%.
- Joint lifetime income, covered spouses aged 72 and 69 at the start: the younger is 69, the highest table age not above 69 is 65, so the table gives 5.5%.
